title.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
title.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed

current_state.zh: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.
current_state.en: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.

updates.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro 高速版
updates.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
updates.what_changed_zh:
Kimi（月之暗面 Moonshot AI）发布 K3.1 Pro，并同时推出速度更快的“高速版”（Highspeed）变体，相关信息发布在 kimi.ai 的博客文章中。此次发布同时附带一项明确政策：不会开源那些会拓展进攻性网络能力绝对前沿的模型权重。

此次发布就哪些能力将被保留为闭源作出了明确的安全承诺，对于一家以开源权重著称的中国实验室而言，这是一个实质性的政策立场。同时有评论者反映，付费订阅套餐的额度很快就被耗尽。

根据被引用的政策表述，K3.1 Pro 的进攻性网络能力在设计上低于其研发管线所能达到的水平，并且仍落后于前沿闭源模型；同时该实验室表示计划逐步提升开源权重中可用的网络能力。评论者还讨论了 kimi.com 上的模型文档以及第三方模型对比页面。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.
updates.background_zh: 月之暗面此前发布了 Kimi K3，Hugging Face 页面将其描述为参数规模 2.8 万亿的开源权重原生多模态智能体模型，具备 100 万 token 上下文窗口。英国 AI 安全研究所（UK AISI）曾发布对 Kimi K3 网络能力的初步评估，而 K3 的开源发布也因蒸馏与网络测试等问题引发前沿实验室和政策制定者的关注。
updates.background_en: Moonshot AI previously shipped Kimi K3, described on Hugging Face as a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight, native multimodal agentic model with a 1-million-token context window. The UK AI Safety Institute published a preliminary assessment of Kimi K3's cyber capabilities, and the K3 open-weight release drew scrutiny from frontier labs and policymakers over distillation and cyber-testing concerns.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 有评论者称，其每月 99 美元的订阅在一次会话中 47 分钟内就触及了 5 小时额度上限，并提醒他人调低对可用额度的预期。其他人则围绕开源权重的理由展开争论，质疑既然承认自己能够做出更强的网络能力为何又选择不做；也有人好奇，一个 1–2TB 的闭源前沿模型在现实中如何被蒸馏。一位开发者报告称，K3.1 Pro 相比 K3 有显著提升，在其对抗性编程语言基准上是得分最高的开源权重模型，但速度慢于 Gemini 4 Argon 和 Fable 5.1。
updates.community_discussion_en: A commenter said a $99/month subscription hit its 5-hour quota within 47 minutes in a single session, and warned others to adjust expectations about usable limits. Others debated the open-weights rationale, asking why the lab would acknowledge it could produce stronger cyber capability but decline to do so, while one questioned how a 1–2TB closed frontier model could realistically be distilled. A developer reported K3.1 Pro as a large improvement over K3 and the highest-scoring open-weight model on their adversarial programming-language benchmark, though slower than Gemini 4 Argon and Fable 5.1.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布对开源权重推理市场具有意义：更强的 Kimi 模型扩大了可自托管或由第三方托管的高能力模型池，从而对闭源 API 的经济性形成压力。与此同时，针对前沿进攻性网络能力保留权重不开源的政策表态，也表明中国实验室的开源分发正越来越多地受到安全与政策考量的约束，这对基于这些权重进行开发的团队是一项需要纳入考量的因素。
updates.market_impact_en: The release matters to the open-weight inference segment: a stronger Kimi model expands the pool of capable models that can be self-hosted or served by third-party providers, which pressures the economics of closed API access. The stated policy of withholding weights for frontier offensive-cyber capability also signals that open-weight distribution by Chinese labs is increasingly conditioned on safety and policy considerations, a factor for anyone building on those weights.
